faqs.question: What items are accepted in the residential blue recycling bin?
faqs.answer: Clean paper, cardboard, rigid plastic bottles (#1 and #2), glass jars, and clean aluminum or tin cans are accepted. Rinse empty.

faqs.question: Can greasy pizza boxes be placed in recycling?
faqs.answer: No. Food-contaminated cardboard cannot be recycled. Place soiled cardboard into the organic compost bin or general trash.

faqs.question: How do I safely dispose of household hazardous waste like paint or batteries?
faqs.answer: Lithium batteries, paints, solvents, and pesticides must not go in curb bins. Submit a Hazardous Pickup Request or visit the Central Depot.

faqs.question: What time should waste bins be set out on collection day?
faqs.answer: Bins must be placed at the curb by 7:00 AM on scheduled collection day or after 7:00 PM the evening prior.

faqs.question: What should I do if my waste collection was missed?
faqs.answer: Ensure bins were set out on time. If missed by the crew, submit a Missed Pickup Request online within 24 hours.

faqs.question: Are plastic grocery bags accepted in curbside recycling?
faqs.answer: No. Plastic bags wrap around sorting equipment. Return plastic bags to participating grocery store drop-off bins.

faqs.question: How can I replace a damaged or stolen waste bin?
faqs.answer: Submit a Bin Replacement Request online. Replacement carts are delivered within 3 business days.

faqs.question: What are the guidelines for yard waste and garden trimmings?
faqs.answer: Place in brown paper yard bags or green organic bins. Branches must be bundled under 4 feet in length and 2 inches in diameter.

faqs.question: Can styrofoam or expanded polystyrene be recycled curbside?
faqs.answer: No. Foam containers are not recyclable curbside. Place in general waste or drop off at designated municipal depots.

faqs.question: How do I dispose of old electronics and appliances (E-waste)?
faqs.answer: E-waste contains heavy metals and cannot go in general trash. Schedule a Special E-Waste Pickup or visit the municipal depot.

faqs.question: What materials belong in the green organic compost bin?
faqs.answer: Food scraps, vegetable peels, coffee grounds, paper towels, yard waste, and certified compostable packaging belong in green bins.

faqs.question: How does holiday waste collection work during statutory holidays?
faqs.answer: Collection schedules shift forward by one day following official holidays (e.g., Monday holiday shifts Monday pickup to Tuesday).

faqs.question: Is medical waste or household sharps allowed in residential trash?
faqs.answer: Sharps must never be placed in general trash. Place in FDA-approved sharps containers and return to pharmacy drop-off sites.

faqs.question: How heavy can residential waste and recycling bins be?
faqs.answer: Standard rolling carts have a maximum weight limit of 200 lbs. Overfilled carts will not be serviced by automated arms.

faqs.question: Where can I drop off extra waste that exceeds regular bin capacity?
faqs.answer: Purchase extra waste tags at municipal centers or drop excess solid waste directly at the City Transfer Station.
